name: professor
description: Claude Code plugins built and maintained with Professor.

plugins.name: sub-agent-compact
plugins.description: Smart auto-compact for Claude Code: a separate compaction point for every sub-agent, and self-compaction at a milestone the model chooses.

plugins.name: cache-live-control
plugins.description: A /cache command that switches the prompt-cache TTL (5m, 1h or automatic) for one chat and its sub-agents, live, with no model turn.

plugins.name: agent-effort
plugins.description: Set each Claude Code sub-agent's reasoning effort per spawn: start the Agent prompt with [effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max].

plugins.name: buddy
plugins.description: Claude Code buddy plugin: Quack the ASCII duck waddles above your prompt and talks back — or bring back your /buddy

plugins.name: callmeter
plugins.description: Records every Claude Code tool call, model request, sub-agent turn and lifecycle event into one local SQLite store, with reports.
